title: StarTracker 1.0.40
startrackerNotes: UEX stock checks prefer fresh reports; stale rows fall back to week averages instead of old spikes.
Trade/smuggler terminal picks favor stocked + fresh + 4.10.2-tagged terminals before raw cheapest price.
Stock UI shows freshness, age, game version, and stale warnings per terminal.
Patch notes keep RSI link cards for 4.10.2 / 4.10.1 even when wiki lag or headless fetch fails.
Party join tracking deduped so the same invite does not spam the session log.

title: StarTracker 1.0.39
startrackerNotes: Bundled mission payout index (1819 wiki missions, 536 with reward_min) for offline contract estimates.
When a contract UUID has no datamined payout, StarTracker borrows reward_min from same-title wiki variants.
Title-only payout estimates when Game.log omits contractDefinitionId; UEX contracts as fallback.
Optional SC Codex API key (config.json scCodexApiKey) for patch-scoped reward_auec_min/max.

title: StarTracker 1.0.38
startrackerNotes: Alpha 4.10.2 support: RSI Discovery Month patch notes (21351) plus 4.10.1 / 4.10 / 4.9 / 4.8.x.
Refreshed bundled catalog seed (ships, items, terminals, shops) for 4.10.2 LIVE.
Exec hangar timer seed updated for 4.10.2-LIVE server 12881860. Use Sync cycle after major patches.
Game loops: RSI Discovery Month entry covering Centaurus rental and Stanton contract tracks.

title: StarTracker 1.0.37
startrackerNotes: Shared fetch/cache utilities across intel panels.
Lazy-loaded session panels for snappier startup.
MobiGlas theme refresh.

title: StarTracker 1.0.36
startrackerNotes: Alpha 4.10 Siege of Orison support: RSI patch notes page 21293 plus existing 4.9 / 4.8.x notes.
Refreshed bundled catalog seed (ships, items, terminals) for 4.10 LIVE.
Exec hangar timer seed label updated for 4.10. Use Sync cycle after major patches.
Star Strings installer pulls the latest MrKraken release on install/update.

title: StarTracker 1.0.30
startrackerNotes: Ignore passenger Quantum Drive Arrivals (only count QT on ships you piloted).
Track location visits, party joins, mission organization/type, and emergency-services HUD.
Overview shows QT jumps and locations visited.

title: StarTracker 1.0.29
startrackerNotes: Alpha 4.9 Frontier Tensions support: RSI patch notes page 21245 plus existing 4.8.x notes.
Restore quantum travel tracking for 4.9 (Quantum Drive Arrived notices; old zone-transition QT lines are gone).
Track Objective Withdrawn HUD lines alongside New / Complete objectives.
Game loops: Recco Battaglia Support the Miners and Wikelo Emporium entries.

title: StarTracker 1.0.28
startrackerNotes: New Wikelo Emporium tab group: trade-in items and rewards from star-citizen.wiki, with category filters and expandable haul lists.

title: StarTracker 1.0.12
startrackerNotes: Fix startup hang caused by a syntax error in app.js (1.0.11 regression).

title: StarTracker 1.0.11
startrackerNotes: Credits to now shows integrated data stack: wiki/scunpacked, UEX, RSI Starmap, SCodex, HubCitizen, OmniCore.
Cross-reference links on catalog items, trade/smuggler terminals (RSI Starmap + wiki locations).
Starmap system quick-jumps on Credits to tab.

title: StarTracker 1.0.10
startrackerNotes: Loadout panel matches combat card layout (weapons + armor only). Combat intel tab removed.
Smuggler routes show live UEX stock column with terminal matching and refresh.
Ship builder favorites strip (like Jump to) with star pins on hull picker.
All tabs show emoji icons and category color dots. MobiGlas-style panel framing.

title: StarTracker 1.0.9
startrackerNotes: Patch notes tab shows full game patch content inline: features, bug fixes, known issues.
Fixed broken RSI links; Wiki mirror link added. Refresh button pulls latest from star-citizen.wiki.

title: StarTracker 1.0.7
startrackerNotes: Refinery: full station list with fees, ore yield reference table, compact calculator layout.
Smuggler routes: row expand fixed, commodity column, buy/sell/stock detail on click.
Trade route row expand fixed. Tab order: Log archive last in Session, Credits to last in Intel.
HUD UI polish retained with cleaner refinery and smuggling panels.

title: StarTracker 1.0.6
startrackerNotes: In-app updates now detect newer builds even when the version number matches.
Terminal trade routes, loadout combat cards, refinery and smuggler overhauls from 1.0.5 follow-up.
Use Check for updates in the footer or the Install update banner when a release is ready.

title: StarTracker 1.0.5
startrackerNotes: Terminal trade routes and smuggler intel: buy/sell terminals, live stock and demand caps, color-coded risk.
Loadout tab: combat-only weapon and armor cards with wiki stats. Food, drinks, and cosmetics hidden.
Refinery calculator overhaul, crafting inline row details, ship builder caching and open sections.
Reputation moved to Session. Tools hub renamed to Credits to. Better item display names from Game.log.

title: StarTracker 1.0.4
startrackerNotes: Intel hub: fleet compare, ship builder with wiki hardpoints, combat stats from the datamine.
Guides: UEX commodities, smuggler routes with live spread, mining sell prices.
Awarded X aUEC HUD lines still missing on many builds; wiki payout estimates fill the gap.
